_comment: Third-party expression that ships with this fork but does NOT come from the
npm dependency closure, so the dependency walk in
scripts/generate-third-party-notices.cjs cannot discover it. Consumed by that
script to emit the 'Non-npm third-party sources' section of
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Keep every entry's licenseText byte-exact to the
upstream license file; do not paraphrase.
